reviews.text:
Recently, my cat seemed different than usual, so I was looking for a place where I could get her examined after work. I found this clinic and was able to get her examined at night. Dr. Nakanishi, who examined her, and all the staff were very polite and kind, so I felt at ease entrusting my beloved cat to them, and I had absolutely no worries. Thank you so much for everything! 🍀
After telling me that there was nothing wrong at this stage of the examination, the doctor spoke to me in more detail and asked if I wanted to have tests done, considering the possibility of such tests. He thoughtfully considered my concerns and explained what the subsequent tests would entail in an easy-to-understand way, leaving me in their hands. If you've had concerns at other clinics and are looking for a good clinic, I think you can't go wrong with this one!
I plan to have all future health checkups done here, so I would appreciate it if you could take care of my family member again then!
The teacher is very kind and helpful.

We brought our cat to this hospital for an examination on the very day we brought her home.

The hospital was very clean, and the head veterinarian was very kind.

During the examination, the doctor seemed to be very attentive to our cat, and we didn't feel uncomfortable at all. We would like this doctor to examine our other cats in the future.

The receptionist was also very kind and helpful, and the phone service was excellent.

We will definitely come back for another examination.

I use this clinic regularly.

It's easy to make appointments, and they're always on time.

The director and reception staff are all very nice.

We recently welcomed a dog into our home, and this time we needed a rabies vaccination. After researching many pet hospitals, we chose this one because of its excellent reviews!

The head veterinarian was incredibly kind, and they patiently answered all our questions and provided helpful information about various websites, making us feel that this is a very trustworthy veterinarian and clinic. 👀❤️

We've already booked our next vaccination appointment, and we hope to consult with you again regarding future visits and other matters!

It was our first visit, and we feel incredibly reassured and truly happy.

We had our 9-month-old cat spayed at this clinic. We considered a larger hospital, but we felt more at ease knowing that a trustworthy doctor would perform the surgery rather than not knowing which doctor would be in charge. We chose this clinic based on its high ratings in online reviews and the reassurance that the head doctor himself has adopted rescue cats. The explanation of the test results was easy to understand, the wound was clean, and two weeks after the surgery, the recovery is going well, which is a great relief. It's also helpful that this local clinic performs surgeries on weekends. The doctor, nurses, and reception staff were all calm and kind, and our cat was very relaxed in the examination room. This is a hospital we would like to use regularly.

We sincerely apologize for not meeting your expectations. Thank you for your feedback.

Selene Pet Clinic, Nishi-Shinjuku

Thank you for your review. We will continue to strive to meet your expectations.

All of us at Nishi-Shinjuku Selene Pet Clinic

We've used their services several times. While the consultation fee might be a little high because they treat exotic animals and offer evening appointments, we appreciate being able to go there in nighttime emergencies. We've used their services for our Richardson's ground squirrel, Munchkin cat, and Japanese fire-bellied newt.

I received excellent care for my sugar glider, Momo. When I took her to the hospital, she was diagnosed with severe heart failure, but she managed to survive for a few days. I chose euthanasia, and the cremation was completed a short while ago. I wanted to express my gratitude, so I apologize for writing this review. I am truly grateful for such a wonderful hospital. I am so glad I chose and trusted Selene. The doctor was incredibly kind and knowledgeable, and the receptionist spoke to me so kindly, which really comforted me. I would highly recommend this hospital. Of course, what works for one person and what works for another animal may not work for another, but I was very satisfied. I believe they provided the best possible treatment. I have another pet, so I will likely be using your services again in the future. Thank you so much.
